description: This file defines a UI component 'TripDetailsScreen' for displaying detailed information about a trip, including itinerary days, with functionality to add items and navigate back.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes component state with theme colors, trip data structure, and title.

methods.name: mounted
methods.description: Fetches trip data asynchronously after component mounts.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a new item to the specified day in the trip and updates the trip data.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates the user back to the previous screen.
